Photography Individual Coaching

Denton Hoyer

Whether you're purchasing your first camera, exploring a new photographic technique, or refining an established practice, personalized one-on-one coaching provides instruction tailored to your goals and experience. Students may work with any photographic tool, including smartphones, digital cameras, or medium and large format film cameras. Sessions can focus on camera selection and operation, lighting, film developing, film scanning and digitization, or digital editing in Lightroom. Individual coaching is also available for a wide range of photographic interests, including portraits, wildlife, sports, travel, children, events, weddings, and personal creative projects. Each session is 1½ hours and scheduled with the instructor to fit your availability. Reserve a single session or continue with multiple sessions as your skills and projects evolve. Tuition is $90 for each 1½ hour session.   To schedule a session, please contact Astrid Bernard, registrar, at
